verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a dedicated Triggers feature that lets an MCP server surface upstream events which consumers subscribe to, with Smithery proxying the subscribe call and delivering events directly to the consumer (not polling-based). This directly matches the story of subscribing to downstream app events instead of polling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of triggers working in production, and detail on how a developer's agent actually configures/receives these webhook-style events end-to-end.
